Definition: middle voice from a derivative of the same as G3984; to traverse, i.e. travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.); --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk.
BiblicalUsage: Poreuomai means to go, to travel, to depart, and it is one of the commonest verbs in the New Testament. Jesus uses it for the great commission, Go ye therefore and teach all nations, and for his own going to prepare a place for his people.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Christian life is a going life, because the Lord who went to prepare a place also sends us out to tell the world.
